color_triad._note: The visibility system for the meta layer

green.meaning: GROUND GROWING — the physical, real, nailed down
green.in_hud: everything visible and static — text, images, data bones

pink.meaning: PERILVERSE — polka dots, cloud filling space, the peril color
pink.in_hud: the invisible stuff we don't see, filling gaps, the metaverse invert
pink.metaphor: pink dots in the space — what fills when green is absent
pink.rgb_anchor: pink = red + white = the warm cloud

ultraviolet.meaning: SPECTRAL — purple strings, beyond visible, the connections
ultraviolet.in_hud: the invisible links and strings connecting everything
ultraviolet.metaphor: spectrum, spectral — you can't see UV but it's there
ultraviolet.rgb_anchor: ultraviolet = beyond blue = the unseen frequency

color_triad.triad: Green (ground) + Pink (peril cloud) + UV (spectral strings) = full visibility

metagram._note: Meta primals, metagrams within the hologram subspace of the HUD
metagram.definition: Anything moving in the HUD that is not nailed down = metagram
metagram.hologram_subspace: The HUD contains a hologram subspace where metagrams live
metagram.metaverse: The metaverse = the sum of all metagrams moving through the HUD
metagram.perilverse: The invert of metaverse = pink cloud = what fills the gaps
metagram.metamath: The mathematics of meta: transformations between visible and invisible
